notes.title: Tactics System, Turn Reset System, and more! (0.2.58)
notes.content:
https://i.postimg.cc/ZK8Y3rZW/0-2-51-Banner-Discord.jpg

Hello everyone!

Thank you everyone for playing our demo!
Right now, we’re excited to bring you the latest update to Guardian Tactics: Deck of the Chosen. 
Here are the details of what’s new, improved, and fixed in this patch:

1.Tactics System
https://i.postimg.cc/SxnyPWqN/0-2-54-Tactics.gif
Players can now select "Tactics" that will offer various benefits playstyles before starting a battle, and again after cleared 4th enemy wave. 
There are total of 8 Tactics that player can choose from.
The effect of Tactics will only be applied to current run.

2.Turn Reset
https://i.postimg.cc/MGRz6qvC/0-2-54-Reset-Turn.gif
Players can now reset current turn by pressing a reset button at the top-right of the screen.
It has total of 5 reset charges per wave.

Important Notes:
- Many UX/UI Improvements such as indicators and bars that indicates status of Guardian and enemies.
- Adjust Monster Wave
- Some secret behind those monsters! ːsteammockingː

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. 
We hope you enjoy the latest updates and improvements.
Let's take back the world from the lethal Android!

Join our Discord Channel for a closer updates with us!
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44925950/62c3206fad749be99b6f1685d9e30695cdad9d31.png

Hope you have a great day! :)
Urnique Studio Team.

notes.title: Official Demo Launched Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

The waiting time for the launch of Guardian Tactics: Deck of the Chosen demo is ended!
It is our second official title from Urnique Studio!
Thank you all for the support along the way, and we are really appreciated!

The demo will be available for everyone, with no time limit to ensure that we can get feedbacks and improve the game consistently.

Bug Reporting & Feedbacks
Join our discord to share your thoughts, or reporting bugs that you may encountered.

The Chosen Contest
We have a challenge for discord community to participate which is:"The Chosen Contest" challenge, to win a chance of getting your name on the game's credit! You can find more information on our Discord server! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925950/62c3206fad749be99b6f1685d9e30695cdad9d31.png

Thank you for your support!
We hope you enjoy with our demo, and looking forward to see you happy with it!

Urnique Studio team.
